objective: T-20260929-03: build a free EDGAR merger-target announcement table and test with signal_card (event mode) whether buying US target stocks at the next open after the 8-K and holding 20 (primary) or 60 sessions beats the universe after 10/20 bp per side and beats re-dated placebos, in all targets and in the small/illiquid t3 tier.
target_regime_and_horizon: Event-driven, single-stock, 20 and 60 session holds after the announcement; full sample 2016-2026 with the recent window from 2024-01-01 reported by signal_card. Not a market-regime bet; validity window is the period in which arbitrage capital is high and spreads are compressed (post-2002).
existing_solution_comparison: `oc research directions check merger` returned only dir:merger_arbitrage_target_announcement_drift (queued, likely repeat 1.00 = this task; no prior local test). Published record: hedged hold-to-close merger arbitrage earns about 4% (Mitchell-Pulvino) to 9.6% (Baker-Savasoglu) per year before the post-2002 spread compression of more than 400 bps (Jetley-Ji); IQ Merger Arbitrage ETF (MNA) shows Sharpe about 0.30 per a search summary (not opened). Existing products exist for hold-to-close arbitrage, but they need completion status and hedges; nothing existing tests the unhedged fixed-horizon next-open long that this workbench can trade. The local step is the missing evidence: data adaptation (free EDGAR), point-in-time timing, 10/20 bp costs and current-window validity. The 2025-10 paper claiming Sharpe above 2.1 is abstract-only (claim_only) and no number is taken from it.
remaining_evidence_gap: Only abstracts were read for Big Moves Small Gains, Baker-Savasoglu and the 2025 working paper; no offer price is in the 8-K pipeline so the price-to-offer conditioning of Bessembinder-Zhang cannot be replicated; completion status is not used (survivorship), so hold-to-close is untested. Recall of the rule (phrase search on Agreement and Plan of Merger/Reorganization) is not measured; precision is measured by hand sample.
negative_experiments_checked: Directions registry grep for merger/arbitrage/target/takeover: only the queued row. Sibling 8-K event directions (buyback, Item 4.02, SEO/ATM, spin-off) are all evidence_too_weak/not_executable and are different mechanisms. 13G filer-detection false-positive rate of 14% (earlier lesson) is why a 25-row hand check is required before any return is computed.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: signal_card: signal known by close of trade_date, entry at next session open, 10 and 20 bp per side on sum|dw| of a calendar-time equal-weight book; missing open earns zero; universe close >= 5, top 3000 by ADV; long only, no borrow. Prices pass sanitize_price_matrices defaults inside load_market. Small-cap tier costs are stressed by the 20 bp column.
stop_condition: Admit only if all four flags are true at the primary horizon (car_t_ge_3, beats_redated, book_positive_20bp, book_positive_20bp_recent); if the hand-check false-positive rate stays above 15% after rule fixes, mark the direction blocked_data and do not run the cards. No threshold or candidate is changed after seeing results.

sources.claim: High initial target price (day-1 close over offer price) ratios are associated with significant negative abnormal returns of 3.5% over the two months following the announcement; consistent with investor overreaction.
sources.applicability: Direct evidence on the post-announcement window this iteration trades: a subset of targets (high price-to-offer) subsequently under-perform, so an unconditional 20/60 day hold can be diluted or negative. Motivates reporting drift by 1-20 day CAR rather than assuming positive drift.
sources.limitations: Working paper draft April 2015; conditions on offer price which we do not have in the 8-K pipeline; sample and cost treatment not audited here.

sources.claim: The merger arbitrage spread has declined by more than 400 bps since 2002; the decline is economically and statistically significant and part of it is likely permanent (increased arbitrage capital, reduced transaction costs).
sources.applicability: Explains why a plain post-announcement long in targets should earn little after our 10-20 bp per side costs: the day-1 spread already compresses most of the deal premium; only the small residual is available at next-open entry.
sources.limitations: Sample ends around 2008-2009; does not cover 2020s; hedge-fund index returns, not stock-level next-open entries.

sources.claim: 4,750 mergers 1963-1998: risk-arbitrage excess return about 4% per year after transaction costs and the non-linear (put-like) payoff; returns correlate with the market in downturns.
sources.applicability: Classic upper bound for hold-to-close arbitrage: single-digit percent annual excess return with put-like tail, which is far below this workbench's admission bars once 10-20 bp per side is charged on fixed-horizon trades.
sources.limitations: 1963-1998 sample, hold to resolution, hedged long-short; only the publisher page summary was read, not the full paper.

sources.claim: Deal break rates 8% (2,182 mergers 1990-2007) to 22.7% (1901 mergers 1981-1996); friendly deals close 82%, hostile 38%; transaction costs significantly erode arbitrage returns.
sources.applicability: Break risk is why we do not condition on completion: DEFM14A/closing data would select survivors, so only fixed-horizon holds are tested.

sources.claim: The SEC efts.sec.gov full-text search endpoint is free, key-less, covers 2001 onward, returns form/items/CIK/accession per hit.
sources.applicability: Data source for the free EDGAR merger-agreement 8-K pipeline; confirmed locally that hits are per file with items lists.
sources.limitations: README of a third-party wrapper; fair-access User-Agent and <=10 req/s still apply.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Build the EDGAR 8-K merger-target table (free), hand-check 25 random rule-positive rows, then run the four preregistered signal cards (all/t3 x 20/60) with next-open entry, 10/20 bp costs and the built-in redated placebo.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: All four flags true at the primary horizon: date-averaged CAR t >= 3, beats every re-dated placebo, book positive at 20 bp full sample and from 2024.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Any flag false at the primary horizon for both variants, or the hand-check false-positive rate above 15% after rule fixes (then blocked_data).
